중간은 뭉텅이로 빼고 읽음.

This is a Western fantasy romance that leans fully into obsession, devotion, and love taken to extremes. What begins as a one year contractual marriage between a bored, arrogant nobleman and a scandal ridden lady slowly unravels into something intense, emotional, and deeply consuming.

Matthias Nielsen is the embodiment of cold nobility. Perfect on the surface, emotionally detached, and convinced that life holds nothing capable of surprising him. Eleanor Brinhill shatters that belief almost immediately. Branded as a mad lady by society, she is anything but shallow. Beneath the rumors and strange behavior lies a woman who loves fiercely, acts on instinct, and hides layers of pain, tenderness, and secrets. Her sincerity clashes beautifully with Matthias’s calculated worldview.

The emotional arc is where this story truly shines. Watching an arrogant and distant man fall into regret, desperation, and finally wholehearted devotion is incredibly satisfying. Eleanor’s quiet strength and unfiltered love never feel pitiful, instead they are powerful and unsettling in the best way. Their relationship is messy, obsessive, and sometimes painful, but it is always sincere.

This novel delivers a love that feels unhinged yet pure, dramatic yet grounded in emotion. If you want a story where love dismantles pride, breaks down walls, and demands everything in return, this one leaves a lasting impact well after the final page.
